note: One line per picture event. scripts/voice.py reads this and writes public/vo/<spot>-<id>.wav plus manifest.json with each line's length; the spots time their beats to those lengths. Change a line here and re-run the script; only changed lines are re-voiced.

cashew.text: Your bank app says you have eighteen thousand four hundred dollars.
That is not what you made.
And the tax you owe, but have not paid yet.
What you actually kept? Three thousand, one hundred and twenty.
And you found out in April. From your CPA.
Every account. Every sale. Every bill.
The bill that did not come. The payment that landed twice.
Cashew taps you on the shoulder. One tap. Booked.
Monday, seven oh two. Here is your week.
Close the month in one sitting. Hand your CPA a pack, not a shoebox.

locus.text: Your ad spend is bleeding. And nobody can see where.
You find out at eleven forty seven.
Fourteen tabs open. Nobody knows what to change.
Every store. Every ad account. Every email. Read by seven.
The morning brief. One sentence per brand.
Yesterday, you actually kept four thousand, three hundred and ten.
Today's calls. Scale this. Cut that. Refresh this. Ranked by the money at stake.
What to make next, from what already won.
Running an agency? Every brand. One morning.
